name: ptee-gnp-default-deny
title: GlobalNetworkPolicy: one default-deny for the whole cluster
summary: The cluster-scoped Calico kind. One GlobalNetworkPolicy with namespaceSelector has(projectcalico.org/name) flips every namespaced pod in prod AND dev to default-deny at once, then carves back a single web-to-app path. The zero-trust baseline the rest of the track tightens.
